name: Super Math Buffet
author: Addicting Games
description: Super Math Buffet is a math game with a funny twist! If you are into gross games and need to study your math skills then this game is the one for you! Feed your characters tons of foods like pizza, cake, pasta, and stacks of pancakes. Your goal is to fill him up until he throws up! Believe it or not, the more times you make him vomit, the better you are doing in this game. This game incorporates math skills for you to solve. Get it wrong, and you miss out on some tasty food for your character. Fill him up until it looks like he can’t hold any more food. Look to the barf-o-meter in the right-hand panel to see how you are doing. If you are ready to play a different math skill, click on the menu to change it up. Math doesn’t have to be boring with this funny yet educational game.
